title: A crumb lifted between two digits by about 1 year
summary: Most children pick things up between two digits by about 1 year.
body: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention 1-year movement list says picks things up between pointer and another digit, like small crumbs of food. Those two digits meet on a small piece. The page files this under movement, with what most children do by one year. This card is that pickup. It is not a mealtime rule. The month comes from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention list, which other countries need not copy. Pointer meets a second digit on a crumb, which is the one-year pickup item. The pointer meets a second digit upon a crumb during the one-year pickup.

sources.title: Milestones by 1 Year
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: Movement line: Picks things up between thumb and pointer finger, like small bits of food.
